answers.answer: You may pay the gold instead and keep the green token. The spent gold goes back to the supply.
answers.evidence: Purchase a Development Card: “Gold tokens (jokers) can substitute for any single gem token. Spent gold tokens are returned to the supply.”

answers.answer: Yes. Take one red, one blue and one green. The four-token minimum applies only to taking two tokens of the same color. The piles would then contain zero red, one blue and two green tokens.
answers.evidence: Take 3 Gem Tokens of Different Colors: “Take 1 gem token from each of 3 different color piles.” Take 2 Gem Tokens of the Same Color: “This action is only permitted if there are at least 4 tokens of that color in the supply”.

answers.answer: Directly exchanging gold for a red token is not a listed action or a permitted use described by the joker rule. The summary allows gold to substitute for any single gem token when paying for a development card; spent gold is returned to the supply.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure lists exactly four actions: take three different gems, take two same-color gems, reserve a card, or purchase a card. Purchase payment rules: “Gold tokens (jokers) can substitute for any single gem token. Spent gold tokens are returned to the supply.”

answers.answer: You may not voluntarily pass. You must choose and perform one of the four actions when legal actions are available.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure: “On their turn, a player must perform exactly one of the following four actions”.
